# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by `go run ./cmd/aitk __reference > docs/reference/cli.md`. Do not edit. -->

Global flags: `--json` prints one `aitk.result/v1` object; `-C, --path <dir>` runs as if started in `<dir>`.
Exit codes: 0 success · 1 runtime failure · 2 usage error · 3 gate rejected · 4 conflict.

## `aitk adapters`

Install aitk into AI tools: instructions, MCP server, session hooks

```
aitk adapters
```

## `aitk adapters doctor`

Report which tools are installed and whether their adapters are current

```
aitk adapters doctor [flags]
```

```
      --global   include user-level config
```

## `aitk adapters sync`

Install or update adapters for detected tools (idempotent)

```
aitk adapters sync [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run            show what would change
      --global             also edit user-level config (e.g. ~/.codex/config.toml); backed up first
      --tool stringArray   only this tool (repeatable): claude-code, codex, opencode, gemini-cli, kiro, cursor, copilot, windsurf, cline, roo, aider, junie, qwen-code
```

## `aitk adr`

Architecture decision records (MADR 4)

```
aitk adr
```

## `aitk adr list`

List ADRs

```
aitk adr list
```

## `aitk adr new`

Create the next ADR

```
aitk adr new "<title>"
```

## `aitk audit`

Security audit: dependency vulnerabilities, static analysis, and secrets; records evidence on the active task

```
aitk audit [flags]
```

```
      --tasks   create fix tasks from the findings (one per vulnerable dependency, one per other failing scanner)
```

## `aitk audit install`

Install osv-scanner, the dependency vulnerability scanner aitk audit uses (Homebrew on macOS, else the checksum-verified release binary)

```
aitk audit install [flags]
```

```
      --dir string   directory for the downloaded binary (default ~/.local/bin; %LOCALAPPDATA%\aitk\bin on Windows)
      --no-brew      download the release binary even when Homebrew is available
```

## `aitk brief`

Print the bounded session brief: start every session here

```
aitk brief [flags]
```

```
      --budget int    token budget (default: brief.budget or 4000)
      --task string   brief for this task instead of the active one
```

## `aitk check`

Run the project's check command and record evidence on the active task

```
aitk check
```

## `aitk ci`

Run every gate non-interactively (schemas, secrets, commit messages) for CI

```
aitk ci [flags]
```

```
      --base string   compare against this ref (default: PR base from CI env, else merge base with the default branch)
```

## `aitk close`

Finish the session: apply the Definition of Done, write evidence, handoff, and knowledge

```
aitk close [flags]
```

```
      --knowledge string   lasting finding, or "none" (required)
      --next stringArray   next step for whoever continues (repeatable)
      --status string      hand over unfinished work: in_progress or blocked (skips the Definition of Done)
      --summary string     what changed (required)
      --tag stringArray    tag for the knowledge entry (repeatable)
```

## `aitk deploy`

Run a deploy target from aitk.toml, then deploy.post_check

```
aitk deploy [target]
```

## `aitk doctor`

Validate the project; --fix repairs what is safe

```
aitk doctor [flags]
```

```
      --fix   repair generated files, the AGENTS.md block, and an overfull inbox
```

## `aitk goal`

Goals: the outcomes tasks deliver toward (aitk task new --goal G-1)

```
aitk goal
```

## `aitk goal add`

Add a goal (status planned)

```
aitk goal add "<outcome>" [flags]
```

```
      --id string       goal id (default: next G-<n>)
      --parent string   parent goal id
```

## `aitk goal list`

Goals with task progress

```
aitk goal list
```

## `aitk goal status`

Change a goal's status

```
aitk goal status <id> <planned|active|achieved|dropped>
```

## `aitk hooks`

Install or remove aitk's git hooks (pre-commit, commit-msg, pre-push)

```
aitk hooks
```

## `aitk hooks install`

Add aitk to the git hooks (existing hooks are kept)

```
aitk hooks install
```

## `aitk hooks uninstall`

Remove aitk from the git hooks

```
aitk hooks uninstall
```

## `aitk impact`

Blast radius of the current change: what references each changed file, and which tests cover it

```
aitk impact
```

## `aitk import`

Import tasks from GitHub Issues, BMAD, Superpowers, Spec Kit, OpenSpec, or a markdown checklist

```
aitk import
```

## `aitk import bmad`

Import BMAD tickets (story/bug/spike files; default: search the repository): criteria, status from the plan, risk high → strict

```
aitk import bmad [path ...] [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run   show what would be imported
```

## `aitk import github-issues`

Import issues as tasks (GH-<number>) via the gh CLI

```
aitk import github-issues [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run        show what would be imported
      --label string   only issues with this label
      --limit int      max issues (default 100)
      --repo string    owner/name (default: this repository)
      --state string   open, closed, or all (default "open")
```

## `aitk import markdown`

Import any markdown checklist: each checkbox line becomes a task

```
aitk import markdown [path ...] [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run   show what would be imported
```

## `aitk import openspec`

Import OpenSpec tasks (default: openspec/changes/*/tasks.md)

```
aitk import openspec [path ...] [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run   show what would be imported
```

## `aitk import spec-kit`

Import Spec Kit tasks (default: specs/*/tasks.md)

```
aitk import spec-kit [path ...] [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run   show what would be imported
```

## `aitk import superpowers`

Import Superpowers plans (default: docs/superpowers/plans/*.md): each Task N becomes a task, its steps the criteria

```
aitk import superpowers [path ...] [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run   show what would be imported
```

## `aitk init`

Create aitk.toml, the AGENTS.md block, ai-state.json, and docs/ai/ (idempotent)

```
aitk init [flags]
```

```
      --check string   check command, e.g. "make test" (default: detected)
      --dry-run        show what would be created
      --name string    project name (default: directory name)
```

## `aitk knowledge`

Add, search, compact, and pin project knowledge

```
aitk knowledge
```

## `aitk knowledge add`

Add an entry to the inbox

```
aitk knowledge add "<text>" [flags]
```

```
      --pin               always show in briefs
      --tag stringArray   tag (repeatable); the first tag is the topic
```

## `aitk knowledge compact`

File inbox entries by topic, merge duplicates, archive old entries

```
aitk knowledge compact [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run   report only
```

## `aitk knowledge pin`

Pin entries containing the text

```
aitk knowledge pin "<text match>"
```

## `aitk knowledge search`

Ranked search

```
aitk knowledge search "<query>" [flags]
```

```
      --limit int   max results (default 10)
```

## `aitk log`

Handoffs, newest first: who (which tool) did what

```
aitk log [flags]
```

```
      --limit int     max entries (default 20)
      --task string   only this task
```

## `aitk mcp`

Serve aitk over the Model Context Protocol (stdio by default)

```
aitk mcp [flags]
```

```
      --http string   serve streamable HTTP on this address (e.g. 127.0.0.1:8770) instead of stdio
```

## `aitk migrate`

Convert a v1 ai-toolkit project to v2 (lossless; originals kept in docs/ai/_legacy/)

```
aitk migrate [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run   write nothing; print the report
```

## `aitk plugin`

Plugins: aitk-<name> executables on PATH, enabled in aitk.toml [plugins] enabled

```
aitk plugin
```

## `aitk plugin list`

List discovered plugins, their hooks, and whether they are enabled

```
aitk plugin list
```

## `aitk prompt`

List aitk's slash commands and personas, or print one ready to paste or pipe into any AI tool

```
aitk prompt [command] [text…]
```

## `aitk release`

Version the project: next SemVer from Conventional Commits, CHANGELOG, manifests; --tag commits and tags (never pushes)

```
aitk release [flags]
```

```
      --bump string   auto, major, minor, or patch (default "auto")
      --dry-run       show the version and notes without writing
      --pre string    pre-release label, e.g. rc → 1.4.0-rc.1
      --skip-check    do not run the check command first
      --tag           commit the release files and create an annotated tag
```

## `aitk report`

What was done, what is in progress or blocked, and which tools did it

```
aitk report [flags]
```

```
      --format string   md or json (json is also --json) (default "md")
      --since string    period: e.g. 24h, 7d, 30d, or a date (2026-10-01) (default "7d")
```

## `aitk review`

Record bug-hunt review passes (strict tasks)

```
aitk review
```

## `aitk review pass`

Record one review pass on a task (default: the active task); a reviewer names the task instead of starting it

```
aitk review pass [id] [flags]
```

```
      --findings int   number of problems found in this pass (required) (default -1)
```

## `aitk run`

Work through ready tasks with a headless agent, one at a time, until done or stuck (tasks finish only through aitk close)

```
aitk run [flags]
```

```
      --agent string       claude-code, codex, opencode, or gemini-cli (default: [run] agent)
      --cmd string         custom agent command, run through the shell
      --commit             one commit per task: finished work as a Conventional Commit, unfinished work stashed (needs a clean tree; default: [run] commit)
      --dry-run            show the order without running anything
      --goal string        only tasks of this goal
      --max-attempts int   agent runs per task before handing it over as blocked (default 2)
      --max-tasks int      stop after this many tasks (default 10)
      --tag string         only tasks with this tag
      --timeout int        minutes per agent run (default 60)
```

## `aitk security`

Security standards for tasks (OWASP ASVS 4.0.3)

```
aitk security
```

## `aitk security checklist`

Add the OWASP ASVS checklist to a task (required for strict tasks)

```
aitk security checklist [id]
```

## `aitk setup`

Once per machine: make every installed AI tool recognise aitk projects without being told

```
aitk setup [flags]
```

```
      --dry-run            show what would change
      --remove             remove aitk from the tools' user-level config
      --tool stringArray   only this tool (repeatable)
```

## `aitk switch`

Hand the work to another AI tool: write a handoff and start it with the brief

```
aitk switch <tool> [flags]
```

```
      --note string   why you are switching / what the next tool should know
      --print         print how to start the tool instead of starting it
```

## `aitk task`

Create, start, list, show, and update tasks

```
aitk task
```

## `aitk task block`

Mark a task blocked with a reason

```
aitk task block <id> [flags]
```

```
      --reason string   why it is blocked (required)
```

## `aitk task claim`

Claim a task for this worktree so other agents skip it

```
aitk task claim <id> [flags]
```

```
      --ttl duration   how long the claim lasts (default 4h0m0s)
```

## `aitk task list`

List tasks (open ones by default)

```
aitk task list [flags]
```

```
      --all             include done and cancelled
      --status string   only this status
```

## `aitk task new`

Create a task (status todo)

```
aitk task new "<title>" [flags]
```

```
      --ac stringArray        acceptance criterion, e.g. "Given …, when …, then …" (repeatable)
      --depends stringArray   task that must be done first (repeatable)
      --goal string           goal id (G-…)
      --id string             custom task id (default: random T-xxxx)
      --objective string      one-paragraph objective
      --profile string        pin the risk profile: lite, standard, strict
      --start                 start the task immediately
      --tag stringArray       tag (repeatable)
```

## `aitk task next`

Show the tasks that can be worked on now, in order (dependencies done, not claimed elsewhere)

```
aitk task next [flags]
```

```
      --goal string   only tasks of this goal
      --start         start the first ready task
      --tag string    only tasks with this tag
```

## `aitk task release`

Drop this worktree's claim on a task

```
aitk task release <id> [flags]
```

```
      --force   drop any worktree's claim (use when that worktree is gone)
```

## `aitk task show`

Print one task

```
aitk task show <id>
```

## `aitk task start`

Make a task active in this worktree (status in_progress)

```
aitk task start <id>
```

## `aitk task update`

Edit structured task fields (default: the active task)

```
aitk task update [id] [flags]
```

```
      --ac-done string       mark criteria done, e.g. 1 or 1,3
      --add-ac stringArray   add a criterion (repeatable)
      --note string          append a timestamped note
      --profile string       pin the risk profile
      --status string        new status: todo, in_progress, blocked, or cancelled (done is set by close)
      --tag stringArray      add a tag (repeatable)
```

## `aitk uat`

User acceptance: a script for the tester, and the person's accept/reject decision

```
aitk uat
```

## `aitk uat accept`

Record a person's acceptance (refused for AI agents); completes the task when nothing else blocks it

```
aitk uat accept [id] [flags]
```

```
      --by string     who accepts (default: git user.name)
      --note string   what was tested
```

## `aitk uat reject`

Record a person's rejection; the task goes back to in_progress

```
aitk uat reject [id] [flags]
```

```
      --by string       who rejects (default: git user.name)
      --reason string   what failed (required)
```

## `aitk uat script`

Write docs/ai/uat/<id>.md: scenarios from the acceptance criteria

```
aitk uat script [id] [flags]
```

```
      --force   overwrite an existing script
```

## `aitk version`

Print version information

```
aitk version
```

## `aitk work`

Create a dedicated worktree and branch for a task, claim it, and start it there

```
aitk work <id>
```
